message_content: Sister Xiuqin, are you free in a couple of days? I'd like to come over and see your new embroidery patterns.
Breakfast is ready, let's wake up the children.
Chunmei, the drama on Tianjin TV tonight is really good, have you watched it?
Zhiqiang, remember to eat something, rest early, and don't come back too late.
Hey, kids' dad, breakfast is ready, come and eat!
Big Sister, we're here. Mom has kneaded the dough, so let's start wrapping them.
Fen'er, we said next Monday, February 3, at 2 p.m. at the west gate of Jinghai Park, right?
Me: Zhiqiang, tonight I'm making noodles with gravy and vinegar-flavored shredded potatoes. Xuanxuan has brought in the clothes from the balcony and folded them. The kids are all doing well.
Sister Wang, after stretching this morning, my shoulders and neck feel much more relaxed. Keep it up too!
My daughter has been taken to kindergarten, and I'll pick her up after school in the afternoon.
Mom, I just had my blood pressure measured at the community clinic, 120/75, perfectly normal. Dr. Wang gave me a low-salt diet pamphlet, and I got an extra copy to bring to you and Dad.
Xuanxuan, remember we're going to Xinhua Bookstore after lunch, so get your homework ready first.
Dr. Wang, I'm learning to cook low-salt recipes. Are dishes like wood ear salad and stir-fried celery with pork okay? I should use less salt and soy sauce, right?
I put the sapling at the foot of the north wall. Remember to water it early tomorrow morning.
Honey, today's lecture was very rewarding. The whole family is starting a low-salt diet. Good night
Breakfast is ready. Call the children downstairs to eat.
Chunmei, it is a bit salty. I'll pay attention next time.
Mom, today is Qingming; I cooked millet porridge, don't worry.
Sister Wang, I just steamed some shepherd's purse dumplings. I'll bring you a few to try.
Zhiqiang, is the chair fixed? Thanks for your hard work.
Shufen, shall we go to the park for morning exercise tomorrow? See you at the usual place.
Fen'er, the kids all praised the new low-salt pickles I made today. If you're free this afternoon, I'll give you a call to chat.
Zhiqiang, this afternoon I'll go find Sister Zheng to confirm the stall number. Just drive with peace of mind.

[Jinghai District Agriculture Committee] The materials required for the application for the special agricultural product label you inquired about: product description, photo of the business license copy, and actual product photos. Please submit them to the Agricultural Product Quality and Safety Supervision Section.
Dear, Mingzhe and Yuxin have been safely taken to school. Don't worry.
Shufen, see you at the usual place at 6:40 tomorrow morning. Don't forget.
Honey, remember to buy green beans and tofu for the noodle dish with gravy at noon.
Honey, tonight I'm going to make braised pork ribs with green beans and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Be careful on the way, and let me know when you arrive.
Sister Shufen, it was so nice walking together this morning. Let's meet another day!
Shufen, this morning I watered the roses with rice-washing water and applied cake fertilizer, and the effect is pretty good. I adjusted the watering frequency you mentioned last time. Thank you.
Me: Kids' dad, let's make chive and egg dumplings tonight, and come home a bit earlier after work.
Sister Shufen, the kimchi samples are packed—five jars in all. I'll go over to you in a little while to talk about selling them on consignment. Is that convenient?
Dear, the children are awake and breakfast is ready. Get up and eat.
I: Zhiqiang, the children and I have arrived safely at Mom and Dad's house. Don't worry.
Dear, your lunchbox is in the insulated container. Remember to eat.
Ma Zhiqiang: Xiulan, good luck at the market today. Remember to eat breakfast.
Mom, today at the family meeting we summarized the healthy eating plan. Everyone said it works well, and both the yogurt and multigrain porridge are popular. I'll bring you some in a little while.
Mom, good morning! It's muggy and hot today. Watch out for heatstroke and bring water with you when you go out. I've finished my morning exercise and feel pretty good.
Sister Wang, the big cleanup just finished, and the kitchen and yard are all clean!
Zhiqiang, remember to buy a bag of flower fertilizer after work tonight; the roses in the yard need fertilizing.
Me: Honey, I'm going to the vegetable market now. Anything else you want me to bring for home?
Teacher Han, I started using the eye care method you mentioned today. I set a timer for the children to rest 10 minutes every 40 minutes. Are there any other things to pay attention to?
Mingzhe, breakfast is ready. Remember to eat plenty of the tomato salad.
Sister Xiuqin, I'm really reluctant to see you off today. Let's keep in touch. Take care!
Dear, before you set off, check the tires and documents again. Be careful on the road.
Mom, the kids are all up today. I have arranged for Xuanxuan to study, and Zhezhe and Xinxin to play with building blocks. In the afternoon I'll take them to the park. Don't worry.
Xuanxuan, remember to bring your racket to today's PE class. It's on the shoe cabinet by the door.
Dear, I took the children to water the roses and took a few pictures of the flowers with water droplets. They're so pretty!
Chunmei, I watered the flowers this morning. The roses are blooming beautifully, so I took a few photos and I'll send them to you later.
Me: Sister Zhou, this morning I photographed roses with water droplets and used diagonal composition, but the colors are a bit dark. How can I add light to dark-colored flowers?
Me: Chunmei, you just said that 3 or 4 people in the community want bulk pickled vegetables. How many exactly? Let me make a note.
Honey, I want to handle the pickled vegetables - give some to the neighbors and have Aunt Sun sell the rest for us. What do you think?
Mom, I got up early this morning and saw the falling flowers in the yard were beautiful, so I took a few photos. I'm in a good mood.
Me: I've picked up the bookshelf and the books. Good quality, a full bag.
Mom, it got colder today. Make sure to dress warmly. All is well here, don't worry.
Aunt Sun, I'm going to the vegetable market this morning. Could you set aside 2 jin of green plums for me?
Hello, Teacher Han. Mingxuan's summer practice report has been organized. He'll bring it to school tomorrow for the new semester. What else does he need to prepare?
I checked Mingzhe's summer homework. He hadn't done 7 pages, so I told him to make them up today.
Mom, it's hot today. Don't forget to drink plenty of water.
Sister Zheng, the canning went smoothly this morning, and part of it has already been completed.
Mom, good morning! Today I'm going to the vegetable market to set up a stall and sell pickled vegetables. Wish me luck!
Mom, I've packed up the pickled vegetables this morning and I'm about to deliver them. Remember to take your medicine on time. I'll call you again at noon.
Aunt Zhang, thank you for liking my bellyband. I've already started cutting it out of infant cotton cloth. What size do you think would be appropriate?
Hello, Mrs. Zhang. The 'Carp Playing in the Lotus' bellyband you ordered has started production. Please confirm the baby's height and weight so we can adjust the size. Please reply upon receipt.
Sister Wang, could you please help look after Mingzhe and Yuxin at noon, and make sure they eat and sleep? Thank you!
Zhiqiang, I went to the community library and borrowed a few cookbooks and embroidery books. I'll be home for lunch.
Sis, good morning! I'm taking a rest at home today. I'll cook lunch. What time do you get off work?
Thank you for hosting us these two days, sister. We've arrived at the South Station—let's get together again next time!
Xiulan, good morning! I heard you're back from your trip. Come over and sit for a while when you're free.
Mom, I'll be there around 8:30, let's talk about making pickled vegetables.
Xuanxuan, are you up? Breakfast is ready. Come eat quickly.
Chunmei, come over to my place tomorrow afternoon. I'll brew some tea for you.
Sis, I bought crucian carp and tofu today. I'm making crucian carp and tofu soup tonight—the kids are sure to love it.
Mom, I deposited 500 yuan into the emergency fund today, and now the balance is 2000.
Mom: It's getting colder today. Remember to put on more clothes and don't catch a cold.

[Tianjin Medical Insurance] Dear resident, the 2026 urban and rural residents' medical insurance payment has begun. The individual payment standard is 532 yuan per person per year. Please pay promptly. Reply "Pay" to process online.
Sister Wang, at dinner I told my family about buying the chili sauce today, and they all support me in trying to make it myself!
Big Sister, tonight our whole family took a walk and had a family meeting. The children promised to keep screen time to no more than 1 hour a day. We were all so happy!
Me: Zhiqiang, the computer class is all signed up. It starts at 7 p.m. next Thursday. I bought ribs and vegetables on the way, so I'll make soup at noon.
Me: Fen'er, today I made 12 hair flowers, some in pink floral print and blue cotton patchwork. The dark green one looks really nice, what do you think?
Aunt Wu, I drew a sketch of that petal shape you mentioned, but there are some parts I don't quite understand. Could you give me some guidance?

[Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School] Dear parent, your child Ma Mingxuan has recently failed history and has missed homework assignments. Please contact the head teacher as soon as possible. Reply "Noted" to confirm.
I'm practicing Excel right now. Tonight's class should be no problem.
Zhiqiang, did the millet porridge at breakfast suit your taste? We'll start washing the jars soon; you carry the heavier ones first.
Mom, the community just told me I can join next month's handicraft salon. I'm so happy!
I got the certificate! Thank you for always encouraging me.
Me: Honey, after picking up the kids and having lunch, I'm taking them to Grandma's house to help.
Zhiqiang, the roses in the yard have sprouted! Look how bright red the buds are.
Chunmei, meet at the entrance of the hall at 7:40 tomorrow morning for a stage rehearsal first. Don't forget to bring the props.
Sister Xiuqin, I've worked out this month's craft accounts. The total income is 168 yuan. Could you take a look and see if it's right?
Today the Baduanjin performance won an award, and I got a cashmere scarf! At noon, the whole family made dumplings to celebrate. So happy!
Fen'er, I just checked the education savings account, and there is 3500 yuan in it. Do you want to bring the kids to visit during the summer vacation? Reply when you have time.
I steamed rice cakes tonight. Come home earlier after work and have a taste.
This afternoon I played bead-stringing and color recognition with Yuxin; she learned very seriously! I also warmed milk and cut apples for them, and the three children ate happily.
Sister, today we went to Uncle's house to pay New Year's greetings. Mingxuan got 100 yuan in lucky money, Mingzhe got 150, and the kids were so happy! Uncle and aunt were especially welcoming.

Sis, is your neck any better today? Did the medium-frequency electrotherapy and cupping you mentioned work? I forgot to tell you, my neighbor also uses a blood-activating medicated patch. I'll bring you two patches later.
I picked spinach and spring onions from the vegetable garden, and also brought a jar of sweet garlic. Now I'm going to Chunmei's house, hoping to make peace.
Alipay payment 5.00 yuan. Merchant: Zhang Shufen Supermarket (56 Jingwen Road). Item: wet wipes.
Branches growing and leaves unfolding, quietly awaiting the flowers to bloom.
I said you're just too careless. Don't get upset, and be careful next time. Rest easy!
Got it, I'll wait for you in the snack food section.
Sister Ma, good news! Your stall has been approved. Stall number B12. Please bring your own tables and chairs. See you at the market on April 5-6!

Zhiqiang, I took the children to the library today. Mingxuan borrowed a popular science book, Yuxin borrowed a picture book, and Mingzhe borrowed the comic Dinosaur Adventure. The children were all very happy!
Honey, tonight Mingxuan took the initiative to read 'Little Stories, Big Lessons' to Yuxin, and Mingzhe also finished up his summer homework. Everything is going smoothly, don't worry.
Xiulan, the food you sent was wonderful. The steamed egg custard was especially tender, and the old man ate more than half a bowl. Thank you so much!
Don't take the truck out tonight. Go home and watch the kids. I have to stay at the hospital with Dad.
Got it. I'll stay home and watch the kids tonight, don't worry.
I heard Brother Zhiqiang told an interesting story at noon today about helping someone change a tire in heavy fog.
Just finished sending food to Aunt Zhao. I made chicken soup and scallion pancakes, and got drenched in the rain.
Just pushed the bookshelf over to the window, tidied it up, and put some picture books and children's books on it.
Xiulan, the sunflower and impatiens seeds are ready. When you come, I'll teach you how to plant them.
Mom, I've put away the soy sauce and salt. Remember to prepare dinner according to the new recipe: stir-fried vegetables and mixed grain rice.
Xiufen, I've arrived at my parents' home. Let's cook together.
It's blooming! The first flower in our little garden has bloomed!
Zhiqiang, I picked up all the bookshelf parts from the second-hand market this morning. Let's assemble them together this afternoon.
Packed up the stall. I received 3 procurement business cards and advice from the Agricultural Commission, and I'm feeling great.
Mom, I'm heading out now to pick you up. The medicine and the bags are all ready.

Hello, I'm Wang Qiang, the purchasing representative of the community supermarket. I just tasted your pickled vegetables at the trade fair and am very interested. Would you mind providing your contact information so we can discuss cooperation further?
Sis, tomorrow (August 15) we're celebrating Mom's birthday at Mom and Dad's house. Don't forget to bring the cake.
Mingxuan is responsible for caring for the roses, Mingzhe records the cucumber watering, and Yuxin puts away toys and wipes the table.
The medical insurance premium has been paid in full. I received two vouchers and double-checked them carefully.
Mingzhe got lost at the museum. Fortunately, he was later found at the souvenir counter. I have already given him a stern warning. Don't worry.
Hello, Wutong Renjia, I'll be downstairs on Shengli Street at 7:30. See you then.
Net income from side work in May was 215 yuan; keep it up!

Zhiqiang, the sauce splashed onto the old photo album just now. It can't be wiped off and left a mark. You said it looks like a tree ring. I think that makes sense; let's just treat it as this year's memento.
Haha, right, this mark is like tree rings, recording our flavorful days of this past year. The album is even more special.
I just bought 5 jin of white radishes at the vegetable market and plan to make pickled radish.
Zhiqiang, our household spending on cigarettes and alcohol last month was too high—I checked the accounts. You should smoke less. It saves money and is better for your health, okay?
Mom gave the children red envelopes, 200 yuan each. I plan to use the money to buy long underwear for my parents.
Sweet and sour pork and noodles with gravy.
Ma Mingxuan became the tooth-brushing group leader. He brushed very well tonight and was rewarded with mint candy.
Take Xinxin to get her tooth filled. She was a little nervous. After the dental appointment, I'll make her a small floral cloth doll in the afternoon to cheer her up.
I got the physical examination report. Blood pressure and blood lipids are normal, and the mild anemia is much better. Don't worry.
The new glasses are so clear! I can see the English words clearly, and I no longer have to squint in class.
I've placed two pairs of knitted wool shoes on your stall. Please help me sell them.
Chunmei had just arrived and brought some steamed bean buns from home. They tasted really good. We chatted for a while, and she also introduced an embroidery order.
I was just helping bring out the steamed fish. You rest for now.
Look at these packaging designs. Your pickled vegetables would definitely sell better if you switched to a different bottle.
I'm here, waiting for you at the usual place.
Starting tonight, you're responsible for reminding your younger brother and sister to brush their teeth and checking whether they've brushed for a full two minutes. You're the team leader now!
Xiulan, let's go for a walk together tomorrow at 8 a.m.? See you at the usual place!
I've finished work and I'll be home soon. Let's have a nice meal tonight, just the two of us.
Today I got a 300-yuan perfect attendance bonus and brought home a roast duck. The kids were delighted and the duck was gobbled up in no time.
Xiulan, come over for dumplings tonight, and don't forget to bring the Laba vinegar!
Bought Mingzhe a hot fried flatbread, the kids are delighted, and we're almost at my parents' home.
[XX Bank] Your savings card ending in 1234 spent 28.00 yuan at Chenguang Stationery Store on Jingwen Road at 14:15 on January 15. Balance: XXXX.XX yuan.
Remember to buy some flower fertilizer tomorrow; the sunflowers and impatiens we planted today have already been watered.
Mom, I've finished writing my diary. Could you check it for me?
I'm already on the way; I'll be there in about an hour and a half.
Agreed. From now on, I'll keep accounts every day and not be confused anymore.

Zhiqiang, I was wrong last night. I shouldn't have been so worked up. I made an education spending forecast table a couple of days ago; I'll take a photo and send it to you. Even if we save just 100 yuan a month, in ten years that's 12,000 yuan. How about you smoke one less pack a day? Save 10 yuan, and we can put at least 100 yuan a month into education savings, okay?
Old Sun, the electric bike is a done deal at 380 yuan. I'm riding it home now.

I just ran into Aunt Sun at the vegetable market. She saw my completion certificate and kept praising me for being capable. I bought tofu, spinach, and garlic sprouts. At noon I'll stir-fry garlic sprouts with tofu, and reheat the braised pork and shredded potatoes from the fridge.
The noodles are ready, come and eat! There's also braised beef.
The quilt cover is washed and hung in the yard, smelling fresh. The kitchen range hood has also been scrubbed clean.
The completion ceremony is over. I spoke as an outstanding student and received my certificate, and I feel especially at ease.
I've arrived at the Qiaoshou Fabric Studio at the entrance to Old Street. It took 15 minutes to walk; everything went smoothly.
Xiulan, Guilan and I have already arrived at the community center. Did you bring the registration form? Don't forget it!
I'll move the ladder over to take down the lampshade; you get the broom ready.
（Voice message content omitted）

Dear Ms. Ma Xiulan, you have successfully registered for the community's Double Ninth Festival volunteer service for the elderly. Service time: 9 a.m. on October 11. Meeting point: Jingwen Road Community Service Center, where you will visit two elderly people living alone. Please bring your own protective supplies and follow the staff's arrangements. If you have any questions, please contact Sister Wang from the community. Jingwen Road Community Service Center
Mom, I got A's in both biology and geography!
Great! I'll give you an extra chicken leg tonight!
Payment received: 15 jars of pickled vegetables sold at the sales exhibition, revenue 300.00 yuan, transaction time 2025-04-26 11:30.
Sister, Dad is hospitalized at Jinghai District Hospital. Come quickly.
Xiulan is really hardworking. You've worked hard!
Sister Xiulan, I'll bring osmanthus cake over this afternoon; let's have tea and enjoy the embroidery together.
Father's blood pressure is 135/85. I suggest we take turns going back to my parents' home to cook low-salt meals starting next month. I'll go first.
You've worked hard; take a good rest tonight.
[XX Bank] Your savings card ending in 1234 spent 280.00 yuan at the Medical Device Store on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, at 13:30 on March 28, 2025. Balance: 3,250.50 yuan.
[Qingmei Dental] Ma Yuxin's root canal treatment completed, 200 yuan fee paid, and post-treatment instructions given.
Yulan, the grass carp and pork ribs bought today are really fresh. Tonight I'll make braised fish and stewed ribs.
The paper boats are ready. When it's time, I'll tell the children to set off.
[XX Bank] Your savings card ending in 1234 made a purchase of 350.00 yuan at 09:45 on June 30. Merchant: Mingshi Optical.
Honey, the photo backup is done. I also set up automatic weekly backups. Don't worry.

Today after seeing the doctor, I went to the pharmacy to buy medicated plaster, and also went to the market to buy pork ribs and vegetables. After coming home and applying the plaster, I felt much better.
Sis, I just made 6 fabric hair flowers. Let me show you the photos!
Wow, sis, you made it look so beautiful! Even more exquisite than the factory sample!
Arrived at Mom's house, safe and sound.
Mom and Sister Guilan came to help make zongzi, and the children were in the yard too. It was very lively.
【Community Notice】Thank you for participating in the tree planting activity. You have successfully registered to receive a persimmon tree sapling. Please plant it properly.
That sketch just now made me laugh until my stomach hurt.
Auntie Wu came to pick me up on her electric bike, and we are already heading to her house.
Auntie Ma, the visit checklist is ready. Please come by the community health service center to pick it up whenever it's convenient.
Xiulan, as we just agreed, I’ll handle the cleaning tomorrow, and you’ll handle the blood pressure checks and delivering the pickled vegetables. See you in the stairwell at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
Thank you for visiting Grandma Zhao in Building 16 and Grandpa Li in Building 18 of Jingwen Road Community this morning; the points have been registered.

Yesterday I measured Dad's blood pressure: 135/85, stable. I suggest setting up a health management routine: Mom supervises the blood pressure measurement every morning and evening and posts it in the family group, and the three sisters take turns going back to their parents' home once a month to cook low-salt meals. I'll start first.
Your father praised the tenderloin you served him as delicious, and the children recited nursery rhymes that made everyone happy.
The consignment deal for the pickled vegetables was settled; another batch will be delivered early tomorrow morning.
My back is killing me. Come help me apply a medicated patch.
The spicy cabbage is already on the shelf. Today went really smoothly!
Yingchun made the top ten in her grade in the final exams this time—really impressive.
I just saw a post about that new park in Binhai New Area. I'll take the kids there later.
Ma Xiulan, Happy New Year! Wishing you and your family a happy Spring Festival and all the best!
Wang Guilan, Happy New Year! And I wish your whole family happiness and good health!
Mom's soy-braised beef is really delicious. The New Year's Eve dinner was so abundant. Everyone ate while chatting about the Spring Festival Gala and had a wonderful time.
Got in the car. The children are pressed against the window watching the street scene, so happy.
Sis, we've arrived at South Station, waiting for you at the exit.
Mom, I've bought the Daoxiangcun pastries. I also saw embroidered sachets. Should I bring one for eldest sister?
Bought a ticket at the South Gate of Jingshan Park and went in, ready to climb up to Wanchun Pavilion.
Just arrived at the home in Jinghai. The driver spoke with a Jinghai accent, and they chatted about National Day experiences all the way.
Finally got a seat. The soybean-paste noodle shop is really crowded.
Xinxin is already asleep, and the older two have also taken their baths.
Sister, let me help you prepare breakfast.
It's really congested around Nanluoguxiang, and you can't get a taxi at all. Let's take the bus to Gulou Street and transfer to Metro Line 8. Don't worry, take your time with the kids.
Tonight everyone came to my home for the reunion dinner. The children were all talking about the stone lions of the Forbidden City. It was really lively.
Sister Zhang, early this morning I took the children to Tiananmen Square by subway. The subway was especially crowded, everyone was going to watch the flag-raising ceremony.
On the G8919, the children were excitedly looking out the window. I peeled an orange for Yuxin. Mingxuan and Mingzhe were disobedient and kept trying to take off their coats.
Leave for Tiananmen at 7 a.m. tomorrow; don't forget to bring your camera.
Xiufen, I've brought the rice porridge and broccoli to the hospital. You all take a rest; I'll feed Dad.
Brother, Dad's blood pressure was stable last night. He got up once during the night. I've remembered the precautions for the IV drip.
The millet porridge is ready, the shredded mustard greens are in the fridge, and the children's bread and milk are prepared.
Dad is sick. I need to hurry over to Mom and Dad’s house. Keep an eye on the kid and don’t let him run around.
Xiulan, don't stir-fry the celery too much. Add more wood ear mushrooms. A low-salt diet is good!
I've taken leave; tomorrow morning I'll go to the hospital to see Dad.
Sister, I got the blood pressure monitor and the notebook. I've remembered everything you said: low salt, drink more water, and don't give Dad any pickled vegetables. Don't worry, go home and rest.
Dad said today's millet porridge was especially soft, and the pickled vegetables were tasty too.
Dad ate the dragon whisker noodles I brought and was very happy. He smiled when I told the tree-planting story.
The recipe is quite suitable. Just remember to use less soy sauce and keep the oil and salt amounts in check.
Zhiqiang, my dad is hospitalized. Can you come home earlier tonight to discuss it?
Xiulan, how is your father doing? I just grabbed an extra bunch of cilantro for you. Remember to eat it, and don't tire yourself out.
Sweetie, I've arrived at the ward and brought low-salt dumplings.
Sister, Dad's blood pressure was stable last night. I heated up the breakfast you brought and gave it to him. Don't worry.
Mom, I have put together a low-salt menu with recipes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The white radish and kelp soup base is very light. Please remember to keep a low-salt diet! [Image]
Big sister, Dad's blood pressure was normal today. In the evening I took a half-hour walk with him. He's in good spirits, so don't worry.
Okay, you've worked hard. I'll come back early this weekend to help.
The pickled vegetables have been delivered to the hospital. Dad tasted them and said they tasted good, saying your cooking skills are excellent.
Hurry and take this bowl of just-opened pickled radish to the hospital for Dad to try; it goes perfectly with porridge.
Dad said he wants some porridge. Cook some millet porridge and bring it over.
Dad tasted the pickled vegetables and praised them repeatedly; we were very happy.
Just cleaned up the living room, I'm exhausted. Yuxin is playing with her toys by herself.
Don't forget to post the short video you took to your Moments to attract more people to buy your pickles.
Mingxuan promised to study physics one extra hour every day, so there's no need to worry too much.
Mom, has Dad's blood pressure been measured today? Remember to take his medicine on time.
Xiulan, the medicated plaster is ready. Come to the living room and get it.
Sister Sun, please save me some red chili peppers and pork belly. I'll be at the market soon.
The roast duck was so fragrant; the children ate happily!
This morning, Sister Zhou and I finished the last few stitches on the 'Carp Playing with Lotus' bellyband. We each kept one sample!
I put the old notebook and ballpoint pen on the desk. When you come back, see if there's anything else you need to note down.
I brought you some scallions I grew myself—they're really tender!

I'm considering sales channels for the pickled vegetables: recommendations from acquaintances, the park market, and my neighbor Zhang Shufen is willing to sell them on consignment. Which one do you think is reliable?
Sister Zheng, the pillowcase is embroidered. Would it be convenient for me to bring it to the neighborhood committee at 10:30 today?
The groceries are bought: pork and celery. We'll make dumplings today.
Xiao Ma, the annual eligibility confirmation for the flexible-employment subsidy is about to close. Have you prepared your income certificate? Please reply as soon as possible.
My finger still aches a little, but it's no big deal; just apply some ointment.
The back of my hand got scalded while I was simmering the green plum jam. I already rinsed it with cold water and applied aloe vera gel, so don't worry.
I've bought the rock sugar, and I'll come to your home at 8 o'clock tomorrow to simmer the sauce.
I've already bought the salt and Sichuan peppercorns. I'll be at your place at 7 tomorrow to wash and cut up the ingredients.
After sending Mingzhe and Yuxin off today, I'll go home and tidy up the house.
Xiulan, 10 jin of fresh cucumbers have been set aside as agreed. Come and pick them up at 7:30 tomorrow morning.
Come back home for lunch. I pickled 5 jars of cucumbers today, each about 2 jin.
I've arrived at the station. There are quite a lot of people at the ticket gate, so don't worry.
Yuxin has been handed over to Teacher Han. She said you can just pick her up in the afternoon. I'm going home to prepare some things.
Sister Ma, I saw the pickled vegetable video you posted. How can I buy some? I want two jars of the low-salt kind.
The accounts are settled, the 1200 yuan heating fee has been set aside, rest assured.
Zhiqiang, the heating fee is 1200 yuan. I'll go pay it tomorrow morning. Is that okay?
Sold 17 jars of pickled vegetables today, earning 136 yuan.

In the afternoon, I went to the Wutong Commune food market and bought Chinese cabbage, tofu, fresh garlic shoots, and fresh mushrooms. Sun Guifang also gave me cilantro, and in the evening I made Chinese cabbage and tofu soup.
Xiulan, I just thought it over, I support you learning computers! Tomorrow morning let's go together to the community to sign up for the training class; I'll take a look too.
Sister Zhang, I'll come the day after tomorrow to pick up the 50 glass bottles I ordered, and I'll also buy some salt, sugar, and soy sauce.
Sis, my mom has acute cholecystitis. I have to go to the hospital to take care of her, so I can't help you make the pickled vegetables today. I'm really sorry!
I've dropped off the two kids, and now I'm going to buy groceries.
Dropped Mingzhe off at school. The road was a bit congested today, but at least he wasn't late.
Just washed the clothes and mopped the floor; the tension has eased quite a bit.
Mom, all 28 jars of pickled vegetables you took to the trade fair sold out. That's great!
Today I went to Jingbai Supermarket and bought a photo album, and also asked about redeeming points.
Honey, I paid 272 yuan for the kids' clothes and have recorded it in the accounts.
Zhiqiang, today besides cleaning the windows, don't forget to move the furniture. I've marked where the furniture should go.
Picked up Aunt Wu. On the way, I showed her the newly opened steamed bun shop and tailor shop, and she was very happy.
